title: Browser Work settings permission recovery
publicationScope: Anonymous generic code and regression tests only

patch.format: Unified diff with one line of context and no private blob identifiers
patch.prerequisite: Apply to the corresponding existing browser recovery code and tests; this is not a standalone application

behavior: Recognize explicit browser-disabled-by-Work-settings diagnostics separately from empty inventory and transport failures.
Return a settings action without selecting or falling back to another browser.
Stop entry denials before host and checkpoint callbacks while preserving checkpoint identity, attempt flags and unknown-send locks.
Preserve the settings-denial classification when read-only inspection or session verification reports it.
Update two test fixtures for the evidence module and AbortController.

validation.publicPatchApplyCheck: passed against a temporary fixture of the corresponding predecessor files
validation.publicPatchPrivacyReview: passed static checks and manual diff review

acceptanceBoundary: Synthetic tests and a successful build do not establish browser availability, account login, provider delivery, new send authorization or customer contact.
